justification: The replication verified data/method plausibility by locating the claimed MOOSE classes/algorithms in the public repo and confirming runnable input decks/regression baselines exist. A full end-to-end rerun of the paper's nuclear application demos (including the Table 2 HP microreactor rare-event numbers) was not performed due to build-time constraints and export-controlled BISON input decks. An independent from-scratch Python replication on a standard rare-event benchmark reproduced the qualitative core efficiency ordering (AL-SS ≪ SS ≪ crude MC in true-model evaluations). However, the subset-simulation and AL-SS probability estimates showed large bias vs a high-sample reference on that benchmark, so quantitative accuracy claims were not reproduced. Overall, some core algorithmic claims are supported, but the paper's main application-level quantitative results remain unverified.
